We need to embed each reaction as child of previous precursor? The hierarchical tree: each reaction node is child of a molecule node (the molecule being dissected). Now reaction3 on B2 using template 1914390 maybe cleave the allylic alcohol to give C1 and C2.

C2: O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)   (protected diol) SMILES: O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)

Reaction4 on C1 using template 149040 maybe oxidize alcohol to aldehyde? produce D1 and D2.

D1: C/C=C(C=O)/C   (acrolein derivative) SMILES: C/C=C(C=O)/C

D2: O   (water) SMILES: O

Reaction5 on D1 using template 1914391 maybe hydrolysis to give simple acids: produce final small molecules.
